meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration. ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' in any prefix form, any 'ulw' research wording including combined invocations like 'mass ulw research', 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 围绕任意选题派出多路研究者交叉辩论，输出带引用与图表的深度报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果一件事需要顶住不同观点，把证据追到源码并整理成正式报告。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any question into a cited, multi-perspective report with charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need well-sourced analysis weighing opposing views, ending in a polished report.

howto.what: 装上后,用户明确要求研究时,Claude 先问交付格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),再建最大协作团队按方向分工,设怀疑/红队成员互批;线索循环扩展到枯竭,争议结论用代码验证,最终产出带引用、图表附件的综合报告,过视觉质检与写作校对。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确要求研究时触发:出现 'ulw-research'、'ulw' 研究措辞、'ultradebate' 等请求时,或明确要求做深度研究时;普通提问、调试、收集实现上下文时不触发。

say.text: ulw-research,帮我深度调查可再生能源现状,输出 PDF/DOCX。
say.note: Claude 会先确认格式再组建团队

say.text: 用 hyperdebate 研究远程办公对效率的影响,做成幻灯片。
say.note: 触发辩论式研究并按幻灯片格式交付

say.text: ulw-research 深度查证此开源项目的性能声明,要求代码验证。
say.note: 有争议的性能结论会实际运行代码验证

howto.what_en: On research requests, Claude asks the format (PDF/DOCX default), spawns a max team with skeptics/red-team, loops EXPAND until leads dry, proves contested claims via code, and delivers a cited synthesis gated by visual QA and writing proof.
howto.when_en: Only explicit research demands trigger: 'ulw-research', 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate'/'hyperdebate', or other explicit deep-research requests. Ordinary questions or debugging don't trigger.

say_en.text: ulw-research, deep-investigate renewable energy; deliver PDF and DOCX.
say_en.note: Claude confirms the format, then builds the team.

say_en.text: hyperdebate research: how remote work affects productivity — deliver slides.
ulw-research, verify this project's disputed performance claims by running code.
say_en.note: Contested performance claims get executed-code proof.
